examples.en: She felt happy about the good news.
examples.zh: 她为这个好消息感到高兴。

examples.en: We had a happy weekend together.
examples.zh: 我们一起度过了快乐的周末。

mnemonic.tip: happy 谐音「哈皮」——乐得咧嘴「哈哈」、皮一下就是高兴。

examples.en: He was sad to leave his friends.
examples.zh: 离开朋友让他很难过。

examples.en: The film has a sad ending.
examples.zh: 这部电影结局很伤感。

mnemonic.tip: sad 谐音「塞的」——心里堵得慌、闷闷的就是难过。

examples.en: Dad was angry about the mess.
examples.zh: 爸爸对这乱糟糟的场面很生气。

examples.en: Don't be angry with me.
examples.zh: 别生我的气。

mnemonic.tip: angry 里有 anger(怒火),火气一上来就是 angry。

examples.en: She is afraid of spiders.
examples.zh: 她害怕蜘蛛。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to ask questions.
examples.zh: 别害怕提问。

mnemonic.tip: afraid 谐音「啊,怕的」——一「啊」就是被吓到、害怕。

examples.en: I get nervous before exams.
examples.zh: 考试前我会紧张。

examples.en: She felt nervous on stage.
examples.zh: 在台上她感到紧张。

mnemonic.tip: nerve(神经)+ous,神经绷得紧紧的就是紧张。

examples.en: The kids are excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 孩子们对这次旅行很兴奋。

examples.en: I'm so excited to see you!
examples.zh: 见到你我太激动了！

mnemonic.tip: excite(使兴奋)+ed,人被激起兴致就是 excited。

examples.en: She is worried about her exam.
examples.zh: 她担心她的考试。

examples.en: Don't look so worried.
examples.zh: 别一副忧心忡忡的样子。

mnemonic.tip: worry(担心)+ied,心里挂着事、七上八下就是 worried。

examples.en: I'm bored with this game.
examples.zh: 我玩这个游戏玩腻了。

examples.en: He looked bored during the lesson.
examples.zh: 上课时他看起来很无聊。

mnemonic.tip: bored 由 bore(使厌烦)来,被无聊「钻」得直打哈欠就是 bored;bored 指人,boring 指事物。

examples.en: I was surprised to see her there.
examples.zh: 在那里见到她我很惊讶。

examples.en: He gave me a surprised look.
examples.zh: 他惊讶地看了我一眼。

mnemonic.tip: sur(在上)+prise(抓,同 seize),冷不防被从上抓住、吓一跳就是惊讶。

examples.en: His parents are proud of him.
examples.zh: 他的父母为他感到骄傲。

examples.en: She felt proud of her work.
examples.zh: 她为自己的作品感到自豪。

mnemonic.tip: proud 谐音「炮的」——挺起胸膛像放炮一样神气就是自豪。

examples.en: He was jealous of his brother's bike.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒他哥哥的自行车。

examples.en: Don't be jealous of others.
examples.zh: 别嫉妒别人。

mnemonic.tip: jealous 谐音「接勒斯」——看别人好,心里「结」个疙瘩就是嫉妒。

examples.en: He felt lonely in the new city.
examples.zh: 在这座新城市里他感到孤独。

examples.en: The old man lives a lonely life.
examples.zh: 这位老人过着孤独的生活。

mnemonic.tip: lone(独自,同 alone)+ly,只有一个人、冷冷清清就是孤独。

examples.en: She has a cheerful smile.
examples.zh: 她有一张快活的笑脸。

examples.en: The music made everyone cheerful.
examples.zh: 音乐让每个人都兴高采烈。

mnemonic.tip: cheer(欢呼/加油)+ful(充满),满心欢呼、乐呵呵就是快活的。

examples.en: She was upset about the bad news.
examples.zh: 这个坏消息让她很难过。

examples.en: Don't get upset over small things.
examples.zh: 别为小事心烦。

mnemonic.tip: up(向上)+set(放),心情被「掀」翻、七上八下就是心烦难过。

examples.en: Stay calm and don't panic.
examples.zh: 保持冷静,别慌。

examples.en: The sea was calm this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上海面很平静。

mnemonic.tip: calm 谐音「卡姆」——l不发音;心如止水、稳稳当当就是冷静。

examples.en: I feel relaxed on holiday.
examples.zh: 度假时我感到很放松。

examples.en: He looked calm and relaxed.
examples.zh: 他看起来平静又放松。

mnemonic.tip: relax(放松)+ed,绷紧的自己松了下来就是 relaxed。

examples.en: She feels stressed before a test.
examples.zh: 考试前她感到压力很大。

examples.en: Too much work makes me stressed.
examples.zh: 工作太多让我压力大。

mnemonic.tip: stressed 由 stress(压力)来,被压力「压」得喘不过气就是 stressed。

examples.en: She is confident about the future.
examples.zh: 她对未来充满信心。

examples.en: Speak slowly and sound confident.
examples.zh: 说慢一点,让自己听起来自信。

mnemonic.tip: con(完全)+fid(信任,同 faith)+ent,完全信得过自己就是自信。

examples.en: He is too shy to speak in class.
examples.zh: 他太害羞,不敢在课上发言。

examples.en: She gave a shy smile.
examples.zh: 她腼腆地笑了笑。

mnemonic.tip: shy 谐音「孩」——像小孩见生人躲起来一样就是害羞。

examples.en: Children are curious about everything.
examples.zh: 孩子们对一切都好奇。

examples.en: I'm curious to know what happened.
examples.zh: 我很好奇发生了什么。

mnemonic.tip: curious 谐音「克瑞额斯」——像猫一样「咦这是啥」到处探头就是好奇。

examples.en: I was disappointed with the film.
examples.zh: 这部电影让我失望。

examples.en: She looked disappointed at the result.
examples.zh: 对这个结果她显得很失望。

mnemonic.tip: dis(不)+appoint(指定/约定)+ed,期待的事没兑现就是失望。

examples.en: He was embarrassed when he fell.
examples.zh: 摔倒时他很尴尬。

examples.en: I felt embarrassed about my mistake.
examples.zh: 我为自己的错误感到难为情。

mnemonic.tip: embarrassed 谐音「俺巴热死」——脸「巴」地一下涨红、热得慌就是尴尬。

examples.en: I'm grateful for your help.
examples.zh: 我很感激你的帮助。

examples.en: She felt grateful to her teacher.
examples.zh: 她很感激她的老师。

mnemonic.tip: great(伟大)+ful——把对方的好看得很大，满心感谢就是感激。

examples.en: She was annoyed by the loud noise.
examples.zh: 吵闹声让她很恼火。

examples.en: He got annoyed with his brother.
examples.zh: 他对弟弟感到恼火。

mnemonic.tip: annoyed 谐音「额闹的」——被人「闹」得心烦、有点上火就是恼火。

examples.en: I'm confused by these instructions.
examples.zh: 这些说明让我摸不着头脑。

examples.en: She gave me a confused look.
examples.zh: 她一脸困惑地看着我。

mnemonic.tip: con(一起)+fuse(倒/混,同 fuse熔合)+d,思绪全搅到一起、理不清就是困惑。

examples.en: We were amazed by the magic show.
examples.zh: 魔术表演让我们惊叹不已。

examples.en: I'm amazed at how fast you learn.
examples.zh: 你学得这么快真让我惊讶。

mnemonic.tip: amazed 里有 maze(迷宫),被神奇的事绕得目瞪口呆就是惊奇。

examples.en: I'm glad you came.
examples.zh: 很高兴你来了。

examples.en: She was glad to help.
examples.zh: 她乐意帮忙。

mnemonic.tip: glad 谐音「哥来的」——听说「哥来的」,心里一喜就是高兴。

examples.en: The loud bang frightened the dog.
examples.zh: 巨响吓到了那只狗。

examples.en: She was frightened of the dark.
examples.zh: 她害怕黑暗。

mnemonic.tip: frightened 由 fright(惊吓)来,被吓得心里发毛就是害怕。

examples.en: She was delighted with her present.
examples.zh: 她对礼物欣喜不已。

examples.en: We're delighted to see you.
examples.zh: 见到你我们非常高兴。

mnemonic.tip: delighted 里有 light(光),心里被点亮、喜上眉梢就是非常高兴。

examples.en: She is in a good mood today.
examples.zh: 她今天心情很好。

examples.en: The rain put me in a bad mood.
examples.zh: 下雨让我心情不好。

mnemonic.tip: mood 谐音「目的」反着想——藏 mo+od,内心此刻的状态就是心情。

examples.en: Music can show strong emotion.
examples.zh: 音乐能表达强烈的情感。

examples.en: She couldn't hide her emotions.
examples.zh: 她无法掩饰自己的情绪。

mnemonic.tip: e(向外)+mot(动,同 motion/move)+ion,心里「动」起来、涌出来的就是情感。

examples.en: The joke made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 这个笑话把大家都逗笑了。

examples.en: Don't laugh at other people.
examples.zh: 别嘲笑别人。

mnemonic.tip: laugh 谐音「拉夫」——gh不发音,「哈哈」出声地就是笑。

examples.en: The baby cried all night.
examples.zh: 宝宝哭了一整夜。

examples.en: She cried when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息她哭了。

mnemonic.tip: cry 谐音「卡莱」——「哇」地一声掉眼泪就是哭。

examples.en: She smiled at the little boy.
examples.zh: 她冲小男孩微笑。

examples.en: He has a friendly smile.
examples.zh: 他有一张友善的笑脸。

mnemonic.tip: smile 谐音「斯迈欧」——嘴角轻轻上扬、不出声地就是微笑。

examples.en: I'm scared of the dark.
examples.zh: 我怕黑。

examples.en: The thunder scared the children.
examples.zh: 雷声吓到了孩子们。

mnemonic.tip: scared 由 scare(惊吓)来,被吓得心里「咯噔」一下就是害怕。

examples.en: I had a strange feeling about it.
examples.zh: 我对这事有种奇怪的感觉。

examples.en: Try to understand her feelings.
examples.zh: 试着理解她的感受。

mnemonic.tip: feel(感觉)+ing,心里体会到的东西就是 feeling。

examples.en: She always feels anxious before a big exam.
examples.zh: 大考前她总是感到焦虑。

examples.en: There is no need to be anxious about the results.
examples.zh: 不必为结果担忧。

mnemonic.tip: anx(掐紧)+ious→心像被掐住、喘不过气→焦虑的。

examples.en: He felt ashamed of telling a lie to his mum.
examples.zh: 对妈妈撒了谎，他感到很羞愧。

examples.en: You should be ashamed of laughing at others.
examples.zh: 嘲笑别人，你应该感到惭愧。

mnemonic.tip: a+shame(羞耻)+d，心里装着 shame 就是羞愧的。

examples.en: Everyone was amused by the monkey's funny tricks.
examples.zh: 猴子滑稽的把戏把大家都逗乐了。

examples.en: The teacher looked amused at my strange answer.
examples.zh: 听到我古怪的答案，老师觉得很好笑。

mnemonic.tip: a+muse(逗乐,同 amusement)+d→被逗得咯咯笑→被逗乐的。

examples.en: We were astonished to see snow in early autumn.
examples.zh: 初秋就下雪，我们大为惊讶。

examples.en: She was astonished at how much he had grown.
examples.zh: 他长高了那么多，她惊讶极了。

mnemonic.tip: as+ton(雷,同 thunder 的拉丁亲戚)+ished→像被雷劈到一样→大吃一惊。

examples.en: I was shocked by the news of the accident.
examples.zh: 事故的消息让我很震惊。

examples.en: They looked shocked when they saw the broken window.
examples.zh: 看到破碎的窗户，他们一脸震惊。

mnemonic.tip: shock 本义是电击——像被电到一下，就是震惊。

examples.en: The little girl was terrified of the big dog.
examples.zh: 小女孩被那条大狗吓坏了。

examples.en: He was too terrified to move in the dark.
examples.zh: 黑暗中他吓得一动也不敢动。

mnemonic.tip: terr(吓,同 terrible)+ified→被吓到极点→吓坏的。

words.meaning: 非常兴奋的；激动万分的

examples.en: She was thrilled to win first prize in the contest.
examples.zh: 比赛得了一等奖，她激动万分。

examples.en: We were thrilled about the school trip to the sea.
examples.zh: 要去海边研学，我们兴奋极了。

mnemonic.tip: thrill(战栗)+ed——兴奋得起鸡皮疙瘩、微微发抖→激动万分。

examples.en: He felt miserable when his best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 最好的朋友搬走了，他难受极了。

examples.en: The rainy weather made the whole trip miserable.
examples.zh: 阴雨天让整个旅行变得很糟心。

mnemonic.tip: miser(可怜的)+able→可怜巴巴、苦哈哈→痛苦的。

examples.en: Why do you look so gloomy on such a sunny day?
examples.zh: 大晴天的，你怎么一脸忧郁？

examples.en: The old house was cold and gloomy inside.
examples.zh: 老房子里又冷又阴暗。

mnemonic.tip: gloom(昏暗)+y——天色暗下来，心情也跟着暗下来→忧郁的。

examples.en: He felt depressed after failing the driving test again.
examples.zh: 又一次没通过考试，他很沮丧。

examples.en: Talking to friends helps when you feel depressed.
examples.zh: 情绪低落时，和朋友聊聊会有帮助。

mnemonic.tip: de(向下)+press(压)+ed→心情被往下压→沮丧的。

examples.en: The lost climber grew desperate as night fell.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临，迷路的登山者越来越绝望。

examples.en: She was desperate for a ticket to the concert.
examples.zh: 她太想要一张演唱会的票了。

mnemonic.tip: de(失去)+sper(希望)+ate→希望丢光了→绝望的。

examples.en: Dad was furious when he saw the broken vase.
examples.zh: 看到打碎的花瓶，爸爸勃然大怒。

examples.en: She was furious with me for losing her book.
examples.zh: 我弄丢了她的书，她气坏了。

mnemonic.tip: fury(怒火)+ious→怒火烧到顶点→狂怒的。

examples.en: I felt guilty about eating my sister's chocolate.
examples.zh: 偷吃了妹妹的巧克力，我很内疚。

examples.en: He gave the teacher a guilty look.
examples.zh: 他心虚地看了老师一眼。

mnemonic.tip: guilty 谐音「鬼提」——做了亏心事，总觉得有「鬼」在提着你→内疚。

examples.en: The coach was satisfied with our performance today.
examples.zh: 教练对我们今天的表现很满意。

examples.en: I won't be satisfied until I get it right.
examples.zh: 不做对我是不会满足的。

mnemonic.tip: satis(足够)+fied→心里觉得够了→满意的。

examples.en: Grandpa is content with his quiet life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 爷爷对乡下安静的生活很知足。

examples.en: She seemed content to sit and watch the rain.
examples.zh: 她似乎很满足于坐着看雨。

mnemonic.tip: 内容(content)装满了容器——心被装满、不再多求，就是知足。

examples.en: Mum was pleased with my progress in maths.
examples.zh: 妈妈对我数学上的进步很满意。

examples.en: I'm pleased to meet you at last.
examples.zh: 终于见到你，我很高兴。

mnemonic.tip: please(使高兴)+d→被取悦了→高兴的。

examples.en: The judges were impressed by her confident speech.
examples.zh: 评委对她自信的演讲印象深刻。

examples.en: I was really impressed with your drawing skills.
examples.zh: 你的绘画功夫真让我佩服。

mnemonic.tip: im(向内)+press(压)+ed→在心上压了个印子→印象深刻。

examples.en: The students were eager to know their test results.
examples.zh: 学生们急切地想知道考试结果。

examples.en: He is always eager for new challenges.
examples.zh: 他总是渴望新的挑战。

mnemonic.tip: eager 谐音「易饿」——像饿坏的人见到饭，迫不及待→热切的。

examples.en: She is enthusiastic about every school activity.
examples.zh: 她对每项学校活动都很热情。

examples.en: The new coach gave us an enthusiastic welcome.
examples.zh: 新教练热情地欢迎了我们。

mnemonic.tip: enthusiasm(热情)+tic→浑身是劲、眼里放光→热情的。

examples.en: Stay optimistic even when things go wrong.
examples.zh: 即使事情不顺，也要保持乐观。

examples.en: She is optimistic about passing the exam.
examples.zh: 她乐观地认为自己能通过考试。

mnemonic.tip: optim(最好)+istic→总往最好处想→乐观的。

examples.en: Don't be so pessimistic about your chances.
examples.zh: 别对自己的机会这么悲观。

examples.en: He takes a pessimistic view of everything.
examples.zh: 他看什么都很悲观。

mnemonic.tip: pessim(最坏)+istic→总往最坏处想→悲观的。

examples.en: She is sensitive about her height, so don't joke about it.
examples.zh: 她对身高很敏感，别拿这个开玩笑。

examples.en: A good friend is sensitive to your feelings.
examples.zh: 好朋友会体察你的感受。

mnemonic.tip: sens(感觉)+itive→感觉特别灵→敏感的。

examples.en: She got emotional when saying goodbye to her class.
examples.zh: 和全班道别时，她激动得说不出话。

examples.en: Music is an emotional language that everyone understands.
examples.zh: 音乐是人人都懂的情感语言。

mnemonic.tip: emotion(情感)+al→情感涌上来→情绪激动的。

examples.en: My brother gets moody when he is tired.
examples.zh: 我弟弟一累就阴晴不定。

examples.en: Teenagers are sometimes moody for no reason.
examples.zh: 青少年有时会无缘无故闹情绪。

mnemonic.tip: mood(心情)+y→心情说变就变→喜怒无常的。

examples.en: Grandad gets grumpy when he misses his nap.
examples.zh: 爷爷没睡午觉就爱发脾气。

examples.en: Don't be grumpy — it's only a little rain.
examples.zh: 别气呼呼的，不过是下点小雨。

mnemonic.tip: grumpy 谐音「咕噜比」——嘴里咕咕哝哝，一肚子不高兴。

examples.en: The bad-tempered driver shouted at everyone.
examples.zh: 那个暴脾气的司机对谁都嚷嚷。

examples.en: He gets bad-tempered when he is hungry.
examples.zh: 他一饿就容易发火。

mnemonic.tip: bad(坏)+tempered(脾气的)→坏脾气的。

examples.en: Don't be impatient — the bus will come soon.
examples.zh: 别不耐烦，公交马上就来。

examples.en: He was impatient to open his birthday presents.
examples.zh: 他急着想拆生日礼物。

mnemonic.tip: im(不)+patient(耐心的)→没耐心→不耐烦的。

examples.en: Don't panic if you hear the fire alarm — walk out calmly.
examples.zh: 听到火警别慌，冷静走出去。

examples.en: There was a moment of panic when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 灯灭的那一刻，大家一阵恐慌。

mnemonic.tip: 传说希腊牧神潘(Pan)一声吼把人吓得四散奔逃——panic 由他得名。

examples.en: She overcame her fear of speaking on stage.
examples.zh: 她克服了上台讲话的恐惧。

examples.en: There is nothing to fear in the dark room.
examples.zh: 黑屋子里没什么可怕的。

mnemonic.tip: fear 谐音「非儿」——「非要一个人走夜路」，心里直发怵。

examples.en: The children jumped for joy at the news.
examples.zh: 听到消息，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。

examples.en: Reading brings me great joy every day.
examples.zh: 阅读每天都带给我极大的快乐。

mnemonic.tip: joy 谐音「就爱」——就爱笑哈哈，满心欢喜。

examples.en: To our delight, the match was not cancelled.
examples.zh: 让我们高兴的是，比赛没有取消。

examples.en: The magic show delighted every child there.
examples.zh: 魔术表演让在场的每个孩子都很开心。

mnemonic.tip: delight 里有 light(光)——心里被点亮，满脸放光就是高兴。

examples.en: She looked at her model plane with pride.
examples.zh: 她自豪地看着自己做的飞机模型。

examples.en: The whole town takes pride in its old bridge.
examples.zh: 全镇人都为那座老桥感到骄傲。

mnemonic.tip: proud(自豪的)的名词就是 pride——挺起的胸膛里装着它。

examples.en: He counted to ten to control his anger.
examples.zh: 他数到十来控制自己的怒气。

examples.en: Her face turned red with anger.
examples.zh: 她气得满脸通红。

mnemonic.tip: angry(生气的)的名词——anger 是胸口那团火。

examples.en: The old man was filled with grief for his lost dog.
examples.zh: 老人为走失的狗满心悲伤。

examples.en: Time slowly healed her grief.
examples.zh: 时间慢慢抚平了她的悲痛。

mnemonic.tip: grief 谐音「割里夫」——心口像被割了一下，疼得说不出话。

examples.en: What a pity that you missed the wonderful show!
examples.zh: 你错过了那场精彩演出，太遗憾了！

examples.en: She felt pity for the bird with a broken wing.
examples.zh: 她很同情那只折了翅膀的鸟。

mnemonic.tip: pity 谐音「陪替」——陪着叹气、替人难过，就是同情。

examples.en: We all felt sympathy for the losing team.
examples.zh: 我们都很同情输掉比赛的那支队。

examples.en: She wrote a letter of sympathy to her sick friend.
examples.zh: 她给生病的朋友写了封慰问信。

mnemonic.tip: sym(相同)+pathy(感受)→和你感同身受→同情。

examples.en: The nurse gave the crying boy a sympathetic smile.
examples.zh: 护士对哭泣的男孩投以体谅的微笑。

examples.en: Try to be sympathetic when a friend is in trouble.
examples.zh: 朋友有难时，要多体谅他。

mnemonic.tip: sympathy(同情)+etic→带着同情的。

examples.en: To my relief, my lost keys were in my coat pocket.
examples.zh: 让我松口气的是，钥匙就在大衣口袋里。

examples.en: She gave a sigh of relief when the test ended.
examples.zh: 考试结束，她长舒了一口气。

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+lief(轻,同 light)→心头一轻→宽慰。

examples.en: I was relieved to hear that everyone was safe.
examples.zh: 听说大家都平安，我如释重负。

examples.en: He looked relieved when the plane finally landed.
examples.zh: 飞机终于落地，他一脸轻松。

mnemonic.tip: relieve(减轻)+d→压在心上的石头落了地→宽慰的。

examples.en: You will regret it if you give up now.
examples.zh: 现在放弃，你会后悔的。

examples.en: To my regret, I never learned to swim.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，我一直没学会游泳。

mnemonic.tip: re(一再)+gret(哭)→一想起来就想哭一场→后悔。

examples.en: I envy her chance to travel around the world.
examples.zh: 我羡慕她能环游世界的机会。

examples.en: His new bike was the envy of the whole class.
examples.zh: 他的新自行车让全班同学眼红。

mnemonic.tip: en(向内)+vy(看，同 video 的 vid)→眼睛老往别人那儿瞟→羡慕。

examples.en: The students watched the astronaut with admiration.
examples.zh: 学生们钦佩地望着宇航员。

examples.en: I'm full of admiration for firefighters.
examples.zh: 我对消防员满怀敬佩。

mnemonic.tip: admire(钦佩)+ation→抬头仰望的那份心情→钦佩。

examples.en: There is no doubt that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，熟能生巧。

examples.en: I doubt whether the shop is still open.
examples.zh: 我怀疑那家店还开不开着。

mnemonic.tip: doubt 谐音「刀特」——b 不发音；心里打了个问号，拿不准。

examples.en: We are hopeful about winning the final match.
examples.zh: 我们对赢下决赛抱有希望。

examples.en: She gave me a hopeful smile before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前她给了我一个充满希望的微笑。

mnemonic.tip: hope(希望)+ful(充满)→满怀希望的。

examples.en: The situation is difficult but not hopeless.
examples.zh: 情况很难，但并非没有希望。

examples.en: I'm hopeless at remembering names.
examples.zh: 我记名字差劲极了。

mnemonic.tip: hope(希望)+less(没有)→没希望的；口语里也指「太不擅长」。

examples.en: It takes courage to admit your own mistakes.
examples.zh: 承认自己的错误是需要勇气的。

examples.en: She finally found the courage to speak on stage.
examples.zh: 她终于鼓起勇气登台发言。

mnemonic.tip: cour(心,同法语 coeur)+age→打心底冒出来的劲→勇气。

examples.en: The room went tense before the winner was announced.
examples.zh: 宣布获胜者前，屋里气氛紧张起来。

examples.en: My shoulders get tense when I sit too long.
examples.zh: 坐久了我的肩膀就发紧。

mnemonic.tip: 语法的「时态」也叫 tense——考试一问时态，神经立刻绷紧。

examples.en: I felt uneasy about walking home alone at night.
examples.zh: 夜里独自走回家，我心里不安。

examples.en: There was an uneasy silence in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室里一片令人不安的寂静。

mnemonic.tip: un(不)+easy(安心)→心里不踏实→不安的。

examples.en: The children grew restless during the long speech.
examples.zh: 冗长的讲话让孩子们坐不住了。

examples.en: He spent a restless night before the competition.
examples.zh: 比赛前夜他翻来覆去睡不安稳。

mnemonic.tip: rest(休息)+less(无)→歇不下来→坐立不安的。

examples.en: He got frustrated when the puzzle wouldn't work out.
examples.zh: 拼图老拼不好，他泄气了。

examples.en: Don't feel frustrated — mistakes help you learn.
examples.zh: 别灰心，错误能帮你学习。

mnemonic.tip: frustr(白费)+ated→努力全白费了→泄气的。

examples.en: She felt offended by his rude jokes.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的玩笑让她觉得被冒犯了。

examples.en: Please don't be offended — I was only asking.
examples.zh: 请别见怪，我只是问问。

mnemonic.tip: offend(冒犯)+ed→被戳到了痛处→生气的。

examples.en: The new shoes are beautiful but uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 新鞋好看，穿着却不舒服。

examples.en: He felt uncomfortable talking in front of strangers.
examples.zh: 在陌生人面前讲话，他觉得不自在。

mnemonic.tip: un(不)+comfortable(舒服的)→不舒服的。

examples.en: He needs to learn to control his temper.
examples.zh: 他得学会控制自己的脾气。

examples.en: She is in a bad temper because she slept badly.
examples.zh: 她没睡好，正在气头上。

mnemonic.tip: temper 谐音「太泼」——脾气一上来就太「泼」辣。

examples.en: Deep breathing can help reduce anxiety before exams.
examples.zh: 深呼吸有助于缓解考前焦虑。

examples.en: Her anxiety about the future slowly went away.
examples.zh: 她对未来的焦虑慢慢消散了。

mnemonic.tip: anxious(焦虑的)的名词——揪着的那颗心就是 anxiety。

examples.en: We were horrified to see the mess in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 看到厨房乱成那样，我们惊呆了。

examples.en: She gave a horrified look at the huge spider.
examples.zh: 看到那只大蜘蛛，她一脸惊骇。

mnemonic.tip: horror(恐怖)+ified→被恐怖画面吓到→惊骇的。

examples.en: It's a shame that the picnic was cancelled.
examples.zh: 野餐取消了，真可惜。

examples.en: His face burned with shame after the lie.
examples.zh: 撒谎之后，他羞愧得满脸发烫。

mnemonic.tip: shame 谐音「羞么」——臊得脸红，就是羞愧。

examples.en: The sudden thunder gave me a real fright.
examples.zh: 突然的雷声着实吓了我一跳。

examples.en: The cat jumped back in fright at the balloon.
examples.zh: 猫被气球吓得往后一跳。

mnemonic.tip: frightened(受惊的)的源头——fright 就是那一下「哇」的惊吓。

examples.en: Jealousy can slowly ruin a good friendship.
examples.zh: 嫉妒会慢慢毁掉一段好友谊。

examples.en: He felt a touch of jealousy at her success.
examples.zh: 看到她的成功，他有点儿泛酸。

mnemonic.tip: jealous(嫉妒的)的名词——心里那点酸溜溜就是 jealousy。

examples.en: She screamed when the lights suddenly went out.
examples.zh: 灯突然灭了，她尖叫起来。

examples.en: We heard a scream from the haunted house ride.
examples.zh: 鬼屋项目里传来一声尖叫。

mnemonic.tip: scream 里藏着 cream(奶油)——冰淇淋掉地上，忍不住尖叫。

examples.en: The little boy sobbed over his broken toy.
examples.zh: 小男孩对着摔坏的玩具抽泣。

examples.en: She told the sad story between sobs.
examples.zh: 她一边啜泣一边讲那个伤心的故事。

mnemonic.tip: sob 读音短促低沉——像一抽一抽的哭声，拟声好记。

examples.en: He sighed and started his homework again.
examples.zh: 他叹了口气，重新开始写作业。

examples.en: With a sigh, she closed the empty fridge.
examples.zh: 她叹着气关上了空空的冰箱。

mnemonic.tip: sigh 谐音「唉」——「唉」的一声就是叹气。

examples.en: Her hands trembled as she opened the letter.
examples.zh: 拆信时她的手直发抖。

examples.en: The puppy trembled with cold in the rain.
examples.zh: 小狗在雨里冻得瑟瑟发抖。

mnemonic.tip: tremble 谐音「穿薄」——穿得太薄，冷得发抖。

examples.en: He blushed when the teacher praised him in class.
examples.zh: 老师当堂表扬他，他脸红了。

examples.en: She blushes easily in front of strangers.
examples.zh: 她在陌生人面前动不动就脸红。

mnemonic.tip: 像 blood(血)+rush(涌)的合体——血「唰」地涌上脸→脸红。

examples.en: Dad frowned at the low mark on my report.
examples.zh: 看到成绩单上的低分，爸爸皱起了眉。

examples.en: She looked at the strange bill with a frown.
examples.zh: 她皱着眉打量那张奇怪的账单。

examples.en: The boy grinned from ear to ear at the prize.
examples.zh: 男孩看着奖品，咧开嘴直乐。

examples.en: She gave me a friendly grin and waved.
examples.zh: 她冲我咧嘴一笑，挥了挥手。

mnemonic.tip: grin 谐音「格印」——笑得咧到耳根，牙齿都「印」出来了。

examples.en: The old man wept at the sight of his hometown.
examples.zh: 看到故乡，老人流下了眼泪。

examples.en: She wept quietly at the end of the film.
examples.zh: 电影结尾，她默默流泪。

mnemonic.tip: weep 谐音「呜噗」——「呜呜」地掉眼泪。

examples.en: The crowd gasped when the acrobat slipped.
examples.zh: 杂技演员脚下一滑，全场倒吸一口气。

examples.en: He reached the mountain top with a gasp.
examples.zh: 他喘着粗气登上了山顶。

mnemonic.tip: gasp 谐音「嘎斯」——「嘎」地倒吸一口凉气，惊得说不出话。

examples.en: The stadium was full of excitement before the game.
examples.zh: 开赛前，体育场里一片沸腾。

examples.en: She could hardly hide her excitement about the trip.
examples.zh: 她抑制不住对旅行的兴奋。

mnemonic.tip: excite(使兴奋)+ment→兴奋劲儿。

examples.en: Money alone cannot buy happiness.
examples.zh: 光有钱买不来幸福。

examples.en: Sharing brings more happiness than keeping things.
examples.zh: 分享比独占带来更多快乐。

mnemonic.tip: happy(快乐的)+ness(名词)→快乐本身。

examples.en: A feeling of sadness came over her at the farewell.
examples.zh: 告别时，一阵悲伤涌上她心头。

examples.en: He hid his sadness behind a big smile.
examples.zh: 他用大大的笑容掩住悲伤。

mnemonic.tip: sad(悲伤的)+ness→悲伤这件事。

examples.en: Writing letters helped the sailor forget his loneliness.
examples.zh: 写信帮水手忘掉孤独。

examples.en: A pet can take away much of the loneliness.
examples.zh: 养只宠物能赶走大半孤独。

mnemonic.tip: lonely(孤独的)+ness→孤零零的感觉。

examples.en: His face turned red with embarrassment at the mistake.
examples.zh: 出了错，他尴尬得涨红了脸。

examples.en: To avoid embarrassment, she changed the topic quickly.
examples.zh: 为免尴尬，她赶紧换了话题。

mnemonic.tip: embarrass(使尴尬)+ment→那股想找地缝钻的劲儿。

examples.en: To our disappointment, the museum was closed.
examples.zh: 让我们失望的是，博物馆闭馆了。

examples.en: She couldn't hide her disappointment at the score.
examples.zh: 看到分数，她掩饰不住失望。

mnemonic.tip: disappoint(使失望)+ment→落空的那份心情。

examples.en: He looked at his tidy room with satisfaction.
examples.zh: 他满意地看着整洁的房间。

examples.en: Helping others gives me a real sense of satisfaction.
examples.zh: 帮助别人给我真切的满足感。

mnemonic.tip: satisfy(使满意)+action→心满意足那一下。

examples.en: Practice gave her the confidence to sing solo.
examples.zh: 练习给了她独唱的信心。

examples.en: He answered every question with confidence.
examples.zh: 他自信地回答了每一个问题。

mnemonic.tip: confident(自信的)的名词——心里那股「我能行」。

examples.en: The volunteers worked with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 志愿者们干劲十足。

examples.en: His enthusiasm for science started with a telescope.
examples.zh: 他对科学的热情始于一台望远镜。

mnemonic.tip: en(在内)+thus(神)+iasm→神在心中→浑身来劲→热情。

examples.en: Out of curiosity, she opened the old wooden box.
examples.zh: 出于好奇，她打开了那个旧木箱。

examples.en: Good questions come from curiosity.
examples.zh: 好问题源自好奇心。

mnemonic.tip: curious(好奇的)+ity→那颗东张西望的心。

examples.en: To everyone's amusement, the parrot repeated the teacher.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉学老师说话，把大家逗乐了。

examples.en: The old pier is now a park full of amusements.
examples.zh: 旧码头如今成了满是游乐设施的乐园。

mnemonic.tip: amuse(逗乐)+ment→被逗出来的乐子；amusement park=游乐园。

examples.en: He drew little pictures to fight the boredom.
examples.zh: 他画小画打发无聊。

examples.en: Long waits at the airport are pure boredom.
examples.zh: 在机场干等实在无聊透顶。

mnemonic.tip: bore(使无聊)+dom(状态)→无聊的状态。

examples.en: She said a tearful goodbye to her host family.
examples.zh: 她含泪与寄宿家庭道别。

examples.en: The boy grew tearful when his kite flew away.
examples.zh: 风筝飞走了，男孩眼泪汪汪。

mnemonic.tip: tear(眼泪)+ful(满)→眼里噙满泪的。

examples.en: Keep a positive attitude even on bad days.
examples.zh: 哪怕日子不顺，也要保持积极心态。

examples.en: Are you positive that you locked the door?
examples.zh: 你确定锁门了吗？

mnemonic.tip: posit(放置)+ive→凡事往好处放→积极的；反义 negative。

examples.en: Don't let one bad mark make you negative.
examples.zh: 别让一次低分弄得你灰心丧气。

examples.en: He gave a negative answer to my request.
examples.zh: 他对我的请求给了否定的答复。

mnemonic.tip: neg(否定)+ative→摇头说「不」→消极的、否定的。

examples.en: She was touched by the card her classmates made.
examples.zh: 同学们做的卡片让她很感动。

examples.en: I was deeply touched that you remembered my birthday.
examples.zh: 你记得我的生日，我深受感动。

mnemonic.tip: touch(触摸)+ed→心被轻轻碰了一下→感动的。

examples.en: The film tells a touching story about a guide dog.
examples.zh: 这部电影讲了导盲犬的感人故事。

examples.en: It was touching to see the birds feed their babies.
examples.zh: 看鸟儿喂雏鸟的样子很让人动容。

mnemonic.tip: touched 是人被感动，touching 是事很感人——ing 形容事物。

examples.en: The storm last night was really frightening.
examples.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨真吓人。

examples.en: He told a frightening story around the campfire.
examples.zh: 他在篝火旁讲了个吓人的故事。

mnemonic.tip: frighten(吓唬)+ing→事物本身吓人；frightened 才是人被吓到。

examples.en: The dripping tap made an annoying sound all night.
examples.zh: 滴水的龙头响了一夜，烦死人。

examples.en: It's annoying when people talk during the film.
examples.zh: 看电影时有人讲话很招人烦。

mnemonic.tip: annoy(使恼火)+ing→事物本身烦人；annoyed 是人被惹恼。

examples.en: The end of the story was a bit disappointing.
examples.zh: 故事的结尾有点令人失望。

examples.en: It was a disappointing result after so much practice.
examples.zh: 练了那么久却是这个结果，真让人失望。

mnemonic.tip: disappoint+ing→事让人失望；disappointed 是人感到失望。

examples.en: Falling asleep in class was really embarrassing.
examples.zh: 上课睡着了，真是太尴尬了。

examples.en: He told an embarrassing story about his childhood.
examples.zh: 他讲了自己小时候一件糗事。

mnemonic.tip: embarrass+ing→事让人尴尬；embarrassed 是人觉得尴尬。

examples.en: She was overjoyed to be chosen for the team.
examples.zh: 入选队伍，她欣喜若狂。

examples.en: The family were overjoyed at the good news.
examples.zh: 这个好消息让全家人喜出望外。

mnemonic.tip: over(超过)+joy(欢喜)+ed→高兴过了头→欣喜若狂。

examples.en: He has been feeling down since the match.
examples.zh: 比赛之后他一直情绪低落。

examples.en: When you feel down, go for a walk outside.
examples.zh: 心情低落时，出去走走吧。

mnemonic.tip: down 本义向下——心情也「往下掉」，就是低落。

examples.en: She was heartbroken when her cat went missing.
examples.zh: 猫走丢了，她伤心欲绝。

examples.en: The fans were heartbroken after the last-minute goal.
examples.zh: 最后一分钟丢球，球迷们心都碎了。

mnemonic.tip: heart(心)+broken(碎了)→心碎的。

examples.en: We spent a delightful afternoon by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一个愉快的下午。

examples.en: The bakery is full of delightful smells.
examples.zh: 面包店里满是好闻的香味。

mnemonic.tip: delight(愉快)+ful(充满)→处处让人开心的。

examples.en: She felt homesick during her first week at camp.
examples.zh: 夏令营第一周她很想家。

examples.en: Photos of his mum's cooking made him homesick.
examples.zh: 妈妈做饭的照片勾起了他的乡愁。

mnemonic.tip: home(家)+sick(病)→想家想到「生病」→想家的。

examples.en: I'm thankful for all the help you gave me.
examples.zh: 我很感激你给我的所有帮助。

examples.en: We were thankful that no one was hurt.
examples.zh: 我们庆幸没有人受伤。

mnemonic.tip: thank(感谢)+ful(满)→满心感谢的。

examples.en: The teacher looked puzzled at my strange question.
examples.zh: 老师被我古怪的问题问得一头雾水。

examples.en: I'm still puzzled about how the trick works.
examples.zh: 我还是想不通这个魔术是怎么变的。

mnemonic.tip: puzzle 是拼图——对着拼不上的图直挠头，就是困惑。

examples.en: The disappearing socks are a puzzling mystery.
examples.zh: 袜子总是失踪，真是个费解的谜。

examples.en: It's puzzling that the shop closes at noon.
examples.zh: 那家店中午就关门，让人想不明白。

mnemonic.tip: puzzled 是人犯迷糊，puzzling 是事让人迷糊——ing 形容事物。

examples.en: It is cruel to keep a wild bird in a tiny cage.
examples.zh: 把野鸟关在小笼子里很残忍。

examples.en: Her cruel words hurt him deeply.
examples.zh: 她刻薄的话深深伤了他。

mnemonic.tip: cru(生硬，同 crude 生的)+el→心硬邦邦、冷冰冰→残忍的。

examples.en: Please accept my sincere thanks for your kindness.
examples.zh: 请接受我对你善意的真诚感谢。

examples.en: Her apology sounded completely sincere.
examples.zh: 她的道歉听起来十分诚恳。

mnemonic.tip: sincere 谐音「心透儿」——把心掏出来给你看，就是真诚。

examples.en: The stubborn donkey refused to move a step.
examples.zh: 那头犟驴一步也不肯走。

examples.en: He is too stubborn to say sorry first.
examples.zh: 他太固执，不肯先道歉。

mnemonic.tip: stub(树桩)+born——像树桩一样定在原地，拉都拉不动→固执。

examples.en: It's sensible to check the weather before hiking.
examples.zh: 远足前查看天气是明智的。

examples.en: Be sensible and save some pocket money.
examples.zh: 理智点，存些零花钱吧。

mnemonic.tip: sens(感觉)+ible→懂得掂量轻重→明智的；别和 sensitive(敏感的)混。

examples.en: Our teacher has a great sense of humour.
examples.zh: 我们老师很有幽默感。

examples.en: A good sense of humour makes friends quickly.
examples.zh: 有幽默感的人交朋友很快。

mnemonic.tip: sense(感觉)+humour(幽默)→接得住玩笑、抛得出包袱的本事。

examples.en: Cheer up! Things will get better tomorrow.
examples.zh: 振作点！明天会好起来的。

examples.en: We made funny faces to cheer her up.
examples.zh: 我们做鬼脸逗她开心。

mnemonic.tip: cheer(欢呼)+up(向上)→把心情「呼」地拉上去→振作。

examples.en: Take a deep breath and calm down first.
examples.zh: 先深呼吸，冷静下来。

examples.en: The baby finally calmed down in mum's arms.
examples.zh: 宝宝在妈妈怀里终于安静下来。

mnemonic.tip: calm(平静)+down(下来)→把火气按下去→冷静下来。

examples.en: I'm fed up with doing the dishes every day.
examples.zh: 天天洗碗，我烦透了。

examples.en: She looked fed up with the endless rain.
examples.zh: 没完没了的雨让她一脸厌烦。

mnemonic.tip: feed 的过去分词——被「喂」到嗓子眼，再也装不下→受够了。

examples.en: She burst into tears when she saw her lost puppy again.
examples.zh: 再次见到走失的小狗，她一下子哭了出来。

examples.en: The little boy burst into tears at the loud bang.
examples.zh: 巨响吓得小男孩哇地大哭。

mnemonic.tip: burst(爆发)+into tears(进入眼泪)→眼泪像开闸一样冲出来。

examples.en: She was in tears over the sad ending of the book.
examples.zh: 书的悲伤结局看得她直掉泪。

examples.en: Half the class were in tears at the farewell party.
examples.zh: 欢送会上半个班都哭了。

mnemonic.tip: 泡「在」眼泪里→正流着泪。

examples.en: Dad never loses his temper, even in traffic jams.
examples.zh: 哪怕堵车，爸爸也从不发火。

examples.en: She lost her temper when the printer broke again.
examples.zh: 打印机又坏了，她一下子火了。

mnemonic.tip: 把 temper(脾气)「弄丢」→管不住脾气→发火。

examples.en: We are all looking forward to the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我们都盼着暑假。

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
examples.zh: 期待早日收到你的来信。

mnemonic.tip: look(看)+forward(向前)→伸长脖子往前望→期待；后接 doing。

examples.en: I can't stand the noise from the building site.
examples.zh: 工地的噪音我实在受不了。

examples.en: She can't stand being late for anything.
examples.zh: 她受不了任何事迟到。

mnemonic.tip: stand 本义站立——「站都站不住了」→忍无可忍。

examples.en: I'm sick of hearing the same excuse every time.
examples.zh: 同样的借口听得我耳朵起茧了。

examples.en: He is sick of waiting for the late bus.
examples.zh: 老等这趟晚点的公交，他烦透了。

mnemonic.tip: sick(生病)+of→烦到「想吐」→厌倦。

examples.en: She calmly explained what had happened.
examples.zh: 她冷静地解释了发生的事。

examples.en: Walk calmly to the exit during a fire drill.
examples.zh: 消防演习时要镇定地走向出口。

mnemonic.tip: calm(冷静)+ly(副词)→冷静地。

examples.en: He waited nervously outside the head teacher's office.
examples.zh: 他紧张地在校长办公室外等着。

examples.en: She nervously checked her ticket again and again.
examples.zh: 她紧张地一遍遍查看车票。

mnemonic.tip: nervous(紧张的)+ly→紧张地。

examples.en: He proudly showed us his medal collection.
examples.zh: 他自豪地向我们展示他的奖牌收藏。

examples.en: The winners walked proudly onto the stage.
examples.zh: 获胜者们昂首走上领奖台。

mnemonic.tip: proud(自豪的)+ly→自豪地。

examples.en: The driver shouted angrily at the careless rider.
examples.zh: 司机愤怒地朝那个粗心的骑车人喊。

examples.en: She angrily threw the broken pen into the bin.
examples.zh: 她气呼呼地把坏笔扔进垃圾桶。

mnemonic.tip: angry(生气的)+ly→气冲冲地。

examples.en: The dog looked up sadly at the empty bowl.
examples.zh: 狗悲伤地望着空食盆。

examples.en: Sadly, the old cinema closed down last year.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，那家老电影院去年停业了。

mnemonic.tip: sad(悲伤的)+ly→悲伤地；句首=「遗憾的是」。

examples.en: The children played happily in the snow all morning.
examples.zh: 孩子们在雪地里快活地玩了一上午。

examples.en: Happily, the rain stopped before the picnic.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，野餐前雨停了。

mnemonic.tip: happy(快乐的)+ly→开开心心地；句首=「幸运的是」。
